7	
8	Porting the desktop release action from Windows-only to win+mac+linux surfaced
9	these blockers. Each was reproduced locally, not inferred:
10	
11	- **`clipm` cannot build on macOS.** Its `build` runs `uv run … export_contracts.py`,
12	  and `packages/nodes/clipm/python`'s lock pins `torch==2.4.0+cu121`, which only has
13	  `linux_x86_64` / `win_amd64` wheels. Disabling it in `xiranite.build.toml` is **not**
14	  enough: `@xiranite/node-neoview` depends on it, and turbo builds dependencies of
15	  `--filter=!@xiranite/node-clipm` anyway, so `bun run build:nodes` still dies.
16	  `scripts/build-packages-lazy.ts` is the build entry that genuinely skips disabled
17	  nodes and stays strict on enabled ones.
18	- **`registry-js` breaks `bun build` on non-Windows.** `packages/shell-integration`
19	  reaches it through a literal-specifier dynamic import, so the bundler resolves it at
20	  build time even though the call site is Windows-only; the native binary is absent →
21	  `Could not resolve: ../../build/Release/registry.node`. Fix is `--external registry-js`
22	  for non-win32 targets (Windows keeps it inlined).
23	- **Wails v3 alpha98 on Linux links GTK4, not GTK3.** With no `gtk3` tag its cgo
24	  directives ask pkg-config for `gtk4 webkitgtk-6.0 libsoup-3.0 gio-unix-2.0`, so
25	  `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev`/`libgtk-3-dev` are the wrong packages. `CGO_ENABLED=0` failing
26	  with `undefined: pointer` is just "cgo off"; the `purego` build tag path is broken
27	  upstream and cannot substitute.
28	- **Only `native/prebuilt/win32-x64` is committed.** Other platforms must run
29	  `refresh:native-assets`; per-binding `--only=<id>` now tolerates a brand-new platform
30	  store, and all three bindings (czkawka/findz/arcthumb) do build on darwin-arm64
31	  (arcthumb ≈ 2 min of cargo). `findz`'s shared library is `.dylib`/`.so`, never `findz.dll`.
32	- **仓库根有 `vendor/`（是 git submodule 目录，不是 Go 的 vendor 输出）**，所以 Go 会自动进
33	  vendor 模式并报 `inconsistent vendoring … not marked as explicit in vendor/modules.txt`
34	  ——`vendor/modules.txt` 根本不存在。所有 `go build`/`go vet`/`go test` 都必须带
35	  `-mod=mod`（workflow 里就是这么写的）。尤其别用 `go list -m` 去取模块路径：它同样报这个错，
36	  而 `pkg="$(go list -m)"` 在 `set -e` 下**不会中止**，报错文本会被当成模块路径拼进后面的
37	  命令行，把整步搞成看不懂的失败。模块路径直接读 `go.mod`：
38	  `sed -nE 's/^module[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+).*/\1/p' go.mod`。CI checkout 带
39	  `submodules: recursive`，所以 runner 上同样有这个坑。
40	- **Linux cannot be compile-verified on this Mac**: no Docker, and cgo cross-compiles to
41	  Linux need a GTK/WebKit sysroot. Linux claims stay "unverified" until CI runs them.
42	
43	**Why:** the release was Windows-only for its whole life, so every one of these was an
44	invisible assumption; the first non-Windows build would have failed four steps deep.
45	**How to apply:** when adding or debugging a non-Windows Xiranite build, check this list
46	first, and re-verify each item against current code before quoting it — these are
47	point-in-time facts (2026-09-23). Related: [[release-variants-and-ci-authoring]],
48	[[local-verification-gaps]].

44	async function discoverNodePackages(): Promise<PackageEntry[]> {
45	  const nodesRoot = join(repoRoot, "packages", "nodes")
46	  const dirs = await readdir(nodesRoot, { withFileTypes: true })
47	  const entries: PackageEntry[] = []
48	  for (const dir of dirs) {
49	    if (!dir.isDirectory()) continue
50	    const pkgJsonPath = join(nodesRoot, dir.name, "package.json")
51	    try {
52	      const pkg = await import(pathToFileURL(pkgJsonPath).href, { with: { type: "json" } })
53	      if (pkg.default?.scripts?.build) {
54	        entries.push({ name: pkg.default.name ?? dir.name, id: dir.name, path: join("packages/nodes", dir.name), script: pkg.default.scripts.build })
55	      }
56	    } catch {
57	      // skip
58	    }
59	  }
60	  return entries
61	}

63	async function getLatestMtime(dir: string): Promise<number> {
64	  let latest = 0
65	  try {
66	    const entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true })
67	    for (const entry of entries) {
68	      const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name)
69	      if (entry.isDirectory()) {
70	        latest = Math.max(latest, await getLatestMtime(fullPath))
71	      } else {
72	        const s = await stat(fullPath)
73	        latest = Math.max(latest, s.mtimeMs)
74	      }
75	    }
76	  } catch {
77	    // directory may not exist
78	  }
79	  return latest
80	}

82	async function needsBuild(pkgPath: string): Promise<boolean> {
83	  const fullPath = resolve(repoRoot, pkgPath)
84	  const distPath = join(fullPath, "dist")
85	
86	  const distMtime = await getLatestMtime(distPath)
87	  if (distMtime === 0) return true // dist does not exist or is empty
88	  if (!(await hasExpectedDistFiles(fullPath))) return true
89	
90	  const srcPath = join(fullPath, "src")
91	  const srcMtime = await getLatestMtime(srcPath)
92	
93	  const pkgJsonMtime = (await stat(join(fullPath, "package.json"))).mtimeMs
94	  const tsconfigMtime = (await stat(join(fullPath, "tsconfig.json"))).mtimeMs
95	
96	  const needs = srcMtime > distMtime || pkgJsonMtime > distMtime || tsconfigMtime > distMtime
97	  if (verbose && srcMtime > distMtime) {
98	    console.log(`[debug] ${pkgPath} srcMtime(${new Date(srcMtime).toISOString()}) > distMtime(${new Date(distMtime).toISOString()})`)
99	  }
100	  return needs
101	}

103	async function hasExpectedDistFiles(packagePath: string): Promise<boolean> {
104	  try {
105	    const pkg = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(packagePath, "package.json"), "utf8")) as { exports?: unknown }
106	    const targets = new Set<string>()
107	    collectDistTargets(pkg.exports, targets)
108	    for (const target of targets) {
109	      try {
110	        await access(join(packagePath, target))
111	      } catch {
112	        return false
113	      }
114	    }
115	    return true
116	  } catch {
117	    return false
118	  }
119	}

121	function collectDistTargets(value: unknown, targets: Set<string>): void {
122	  if (typeof value === "string" && value.startsWith("./dist/")) {
123	    targets.add(value.slice(2))
124	    return
125	  }
126	  if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return
127	  for (const child of Object.values(value)) collectDistTargets(child, targets)
128	}

130	async function runBuild(pkg: PackageEntry, cwd: string): Promise<number> {
131	  const shouldBackupDist = Boolean(pkg.id)
132	  const distPath = join(cwd, "dist")
133	  const backupPath = join(cwd, `.dist.local-build-backup-${process.pid}`)
134	  let backedUp = false
135	
136	  if (shouldBackupDist) {
137	    try {
138	      await rm(backupPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
139	      await access(distPath)
140	      await rename(distPath, backupPath)
141	      backedUp = true
142	    } catch {
143	      // A package without a previous dist can still be built normally.
144	    }
145	  }
146	
147	  return await new Promise((resolve) => {
148	    console.log(`[build] ${pkg.name} ...`)
149	    const child = spawn("bun", ["run", "build"], {
150	      cwd,
151	      stdio: "inherit",
152	      shell: true,
153	    })
154	    child.on("exit", async (code) => {
155	      const exitCode = code ?? 1
156	      if (exitCode === 0) {
157	        if (backedUp) await rm(backupPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
158	      } else if (backedUp) {
159	        await rm(distPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
160	        await rename(backupPath, distPath)
161	        console.warn(`[restore] ${pkg.name} previous dist restored after failure`)
162	      }
163	      resolve(exitCode)
164	    })
165	    child.on("error", async () => {
166	      if (backedUp) {
167	        await rm(distPath, { recursive: true, force: true })
168	        await rename(backupPath, distPath)
169	      }
170	      resolve(1)
171	    })
172	  })
173	}

175	async function buildPackages(packages: PackageEntry[], label: string, force = false, preserveDist = false): Promise<{ ok: boolean; built: number; failed: string[] }> {
176	  const failed: string[] = []
177	  // Parallelize up-to-date checks: sequential recursive mtime walks over ~50

180	    pkg,

14	  tests". **Reproduced with an untouched suite**, so it is environmental, not caused by
15	  the change under test — say so explicitly instead of "my test is red".
16	- **`bun run test:browser` needs a Playwright browser** that isn't downloaded
17	  (`chromium_headless_shell-…` missing under `~/Library/Caches/ms-playwright`). Fetching
18	  it mutates the user's machine, so ask rather than auto-install.
19	- **GitHub release asset downloads stall on this box**: `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/
20	  download/…` hung at zero bytes for minutes twice in a row, an hour after the same URL
21	  finished in seconds. Bound downloads with a timeout + retry, and keep a
22	  stage-from-local escape hatch (the repo's `fetch-bun-runtime.ts --from <bun>`).
23	- **What does work and is worth doing**: `go build`/`go test` per tag combination,
24	  `bun run typecheck:app`, `check:source-size`, oxlint, `actionlint` (already installed
25	  via Homebrew), and **rehearsing the whole CI job inside an APFS clone**
26	  (`cp -Rc <repo> /tmp/…`) so the user's running dev session and `dist/`/`build/`
27	  outputs stay untouched. Nested `ref/*` git dirs in the clone inherit `uchg`, so remove
28	  with `chflags -R nouchg` first.
29	- **Step-level rehearsal beats reading the YAML**: parse the workflow, substitute
30	  `${{ matrix.* }}` from the chosen config, write the `run:` body to a file and execute
31	  it — that is how the macOS packaging and the version-resolution steps got real proof
32	  (and it caught a `zip ../release` path bug plus a missing `writeFile` import that no
33	  linter flagged). Same trick for the publish job: put a stub `gh` script on `PATH` and
34	  run the step against a synthetic `release/` tree to confirm the six asset names land
35	  flat and the `view || create` chain behaves.
36	- **Proving a variant really carries no runtime**: build both tag sets from identical
37	  inputs, compare sizes, then grep the target asset's first 4 KB signature in each
38	  binary (present once / absent). Cheaper and stronger than trusting the build tag.
39	- **Simulating "no Bun installed"**: `env PATH=/usr/bin:/bin` while invoking go by
40	  absolute path; also handy for exercising strict-vs-lenient gate branches.

43	  当作 embed 输入（本机那份是 1.4.2），就能跑完 embed→解包→执行→真起后端整条链；
44	  验完 `rm -rf build/wails/bun` 还原。**但这条旁路也放大了 stamp 陷阱**：断言里比的是
45	  「构建打的版本」，用真值打 stamp 通过并不能证明 stamp 落地，必须再打一个错的版本要求它红。
46	- **门禁本身要证伪，不能只看绿**：改了 `go test -run <selector>` 或 `-ldflags -X` 后，

1	---
2	name: cross-platform-release-blockers
3	description: Non-obvious ecosystem blockers that break Xiranite's macOS/Linux desktop release builds (clipm torch cu121 wheel, registry-js in bun build, Wails alpha98 GTK4/WebKitGTK6, native prebuilt stores) and how each was proven
4	metadata:
5	  type: project
6	---
7	
8	Porting the desktop release action from Windows-only to win+mac+linux surfaced
9	these blockers. Each was reproduced locally, not inferred:
10	
11	- **`clipm` cannot build on macOS.** Its `build` runs `uv run … export_contracts.py`,
12	  and `packages/nodes/clipm/python`'s lock pins `torch==2.4.0+cu121`, which only has
13	  `linux_x86_64` / `win_amd64` wheels. Disabling it in `xiranite.build.toml` is **not**
14	  enough: `@xiranite/node-neoview` depends on it, and turbo builds dependencies of
15	  `--filter=!@xiranite/node-clipm` anyway, so `bun run build:nodes` still dies.
16	  `scripts/build-packages-lazy.ts` is the build entry that genuinely skips disabled
17	  nodes and stays strict on enabled ones.
18	- **`registry-js` breaks `bun build` on non-Windows.** `packages/shell-integration`
19	  reaches it through a literal-specifier dynamic import, so the bundler resolves it at
20	  build time even though the call site is Windows-only; the native binary is absent →
21	  `Could not resolve: ../../build/Release/registry.node`. Fix is `--external registry-js`
22	  for non-win32 targets (Windows keeps it inlined).
23	- **Wails v3 alpha98 on Linux links GTK4, not GTK3.** With no `gtk3` tag its cgo
24	  directives ask pkg-config for `gtk4 webkitgtk-6.0 libsoup-3.0 gio-unix-2.0`, so
25	  `libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev`/`libgtk-3-dev` are the wrong packages. `CGO_ENABLED=0` failing
26	  with `undefined: pointer` is just "cgo off"; the `purego` build tag path is broken
27	  upstream and cannot substitute.
28	- **Only `native/prebuilt/win32-x64` is committed.** Other platforms must run
29	  `refresh:native-assets`; per-binding `--only=<id>` now tolerates a brand-new platform
30	  store, and all three bindings (czkawka/findz/arcthumb) do build on darwin-arm64
31	  (arcthumb ≈ 2 min of cargo). `findz`'s shared library is `.dylib`/`.so`, never `findz.dll`.
32	- **仓库根有 `vendor/`（是 git submodule 目录，不是 Go 的 vendor 输出）**，所以 Go 会自动进
33	  vendor 模式并报 `inconsistent vendoring … not marked as explicit in vendor/modules.txt`
34	  ——`vendor/modules.txt` 根本不存在。所有 `go build`/`go vet`/`go test` 都必须带
35	  `-mod=mod`（workflow 里就是这么写的）。尤其别用 `go list -m` 去取模块路径：它同样报这个错，
36	  而 `pkg="$(go list -m)"` 在 `set -e` 下**不会中止**，报错文本会被当成模块路径拼进后面的
37	  命令行，把整步搞成看不懂的失败。模块路径直接读 `go.mod`：
38	  `sed -nE 's/^module[[:space:]]+([^[:space:]]+).*/\1/p' go.mod`。CI checkout 带
39	  `submodules: recursive`，所以 runner 上同样有这个坑。
40	- **Linux cannot be compile-verified on this Mac**: no Docker, and cgo cross-compiles to
41	  Linux need a GTK/WebKit sysroot. Linux claims stay "unverified" until CI runs them.
42	
43	**Why:** the release was Windows-only for its whole life, so every one of these was an
44	invisible assumption; the first non-Windows build would have failed four steps deep.
45	**How to apply:** when adding or debugging a non-Windows Xiranite build, check this list
46	first, and re-verify each item against current code before quoting it — these are
47	point-in-time facts (2026-09-23). Related: [[release-variants-and-ci-authoring]],
48	[[local-verification-gaps]].

### **Assistant**

Checkout 和基础包阶段过了，现在红在 nodes 阶段：一处明显是节点间互相依赖没有拓扑序（Windows 报 `@xiranite/node-crashu/core` 找不到），另四处是 `mdast` 类型找不到。先把两条都查实。



两条都查实了：marku 只声明了 `remark` 却没声明 `mdast` 类型（`@types/mdast` 在我本机是 hoist 侥幸命中）；nodes 阶段完全没有拓扑序（我上一版只给了基础阶段）。先把节点阶段也纳入拓扑，并且让节点发现顺序变成确定的。



锁文件只多了 1 行，`--frozen-lockfile` 过（这正是 CI 的检查）。现在在克隆里删掉**所有** dist，验节点阶段的拓扑序。



节点拓扑修好后又往下暴露一层：`node-neoview` 依赖被构建配置禁用的 `node-clipm` 的类型，而 clipm 的 build 会在 mac/linux 上跑 torch 契约导出。先看 clipm 的构建脚本到底需不需要那一步。



clipm 已经有一条只做类型编译的 `build:tsc`，而契约 JSON 是提交进仓库的——所以正解是：被引用的禁用节点只编声明，绝不跑那个需要 torch 的 python 导出。先确认生成文件在库里。



干净环境整图跑通了：base 15 → 禁用节点声明 3（clipm/lata/scoolp）→ nodes 45 → extra 15 → `Done.`。提交并推。



推到 `7ed7e2c`，第三轮 `desktop-release.yml`（run `35895830748`）正在跑，我在后台盯六条 job。

  "new_string": "async function readWorkspacePackages(): Promise<Map<string, WorkspacePackage>> {\n  const packagesRoot = join(repoRoot, \"packages\")\n  const found = new Map<string, WorkspacePackage>()\n  const read = async (pkgDir: string, relPath: string, id?: string) => {\n    const manifestPath = join(pkgDir, \"package.json\")\n    let manifest: {\n      name?: string\n      scripts?: Record<string, string>\n      dependencies?: Record<string, string>\n      devDependencies?: Record<string, string>\n    }\n    try {\n      manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestPath, \"utf8\"))\n    } catch {\n      return\n    }\n    const name = manifest.name ?? id ?? \"\"\n    if (!name) return\n    found.set(name, {\n      name,\n      id,\n      path: relPath,\n      script: manifest.scripts?.build ?? \"\",\n      dependencies: Object.keys({ ...manifest.dependencies, ...manifest.devDependencies }).filter((dep) => dep.startsWith(\"@xiranite/\")),\n    })\n  }\n  for (const entry of await readdir(packagesRoot, { withFileTypes: true })) {\n    if (!entry.isDirectory()) continue\n    if (entry.name !== \"nodes\") {\n      await read(join(packagesRoot, entry.name), join(\"packages\", entry.name))\n      continue\n    }\n    // Node packages live one level deeper, and their directory name is the node id\n    // used by the build filter and the dist-backup behaviour in runBuild.\n    for (const node of await readdir(join(packagesRoot, \"nodes\"), { withFileTypes: true })) {\n      if (node.isDirectory()) await read(join(packagesRoot, \"nodes\", node.name), join(\"packages/nodes\", node.name), node.name)\n    }\n  }\n  return found\n}\n\n// buildOrder returns every package the seeds need, dependencies first, and only\n// among the names `allowed` permits. A phase passes its own scope so a node that\n// depends on a shared package does not pull that package back into the node\n// phase, and a disabled node is never built as a side effect.\nfunction buildOrder(seeds: string[], packages: Map<string, WorkspacePackage>, label: string, allowed?: Set<string>): PackageEntry[] {\n  const ordered: PackageEntry[] = []\n  const state = new Map<string, \"visiting\" | \"done\">()\n  const visit = (name: string, trail: string[]) => {\n    const mark = state.get(name)\n    if (mark === \"done\") return\n    if (mark === \"visiting\") throw new Error(`${label}: workspace dependency cycle: ${[...trail, name].join(\" -> \")}`)\n    const pkg = packages.get(name)\n    if (!pkg) throw new Error(`${label}: unknown workspace package ${name}`)\n    state.set(name, \"visiting\")\n    for (const dependency of pkg.dependencies) {\n      if (packages.has(dependency) && (!allowed || allowed.has(dependency))) visit(dependency, [...trail, name])\n    }\n    state.set(name, \"done\")\n    if (pkg.script) ordered.push({ name: pkg.name, path: pkg.path, script: pkg.script, id: pkg.id, dependencies: pkg.dependencies })\n  }\n  for (const seed of seeds) visit(seed, [])\n  return ordered\n}",

Node\n// packages are not part of this map, so their already-built dists are trusted and\n// simply not emitted here.\nfunction buildOrder(seeds: string[], packages: Map<string, WorkspacePackage>, label: string): PackageEntry[] {\n  const ordered: PackageEntry[] = []\n  const state = new Map<string, \"visiting\" | \"done\">()\n  const visit = (name: string, trail: string[]) => {\n    const mark = state.get(name)\n    if (mark === \"done\") return\n    if (mark === \"visiting\") throw new Error(`${label}: workspace dependency cycle: ${[...trail, name].join(\" -> \")}`)\n    const pkg = packages.get(name)\n    if (!pkg) throw new Error(`${label}: unknown workspace package ${name}`)\n    state.set(name, \"visiting\")\n    for (const dependency of pkg.dependencies) {\n      if (packages.has(dependency)) visit(dependency, [...trail, name])\n    }\n    state.set(name, \"done\")\n    if (pkg.script) ordered.push({ name: pkg.name, path: pkg.path, script: pkg.script })\n  }\n  for (const seed of seeds) visit(seed, [])\n  return ordered\n}"
